sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head length including mandibles 1.93, length without mandibles 1.52, head width 0.68, mandible length 0.88 mm; the mandibles are extremely long in proportion. Close to Microcerotermes parvus. Type locality Luluabourg, Belgian Congo, collected by Callewaert, the type specimens in the Tervuren and Stockholm museums.

note: Adapted from the original description by Sjöstedt (1925), original in German; it is a brief diagnostic description of the soldier (vorläufige Mitteilung) and describes the soldier only.
